name: A J Packaging
summary: A J Packaging, incorporated in Hyderabad in 1995, makes oval, rectangular and round metal tin cans for FMCG and paint makers such as Asian Paints, Haldiram's and CCL Products, from plants in Hyderabad and Ghaziabad. Revenue fell from ₹210 cr in FY24 to ₹193 cr in FY25 and then rose to ₹223 cr in FY26, while profit after tax rose 54.5% to ₹7.9 cr in FY26, though the net margin is still thin at 3.6%. The ₹54 cr issue is mostly fresh money (₹49.5 cr), and the DRHP put ₹24.5 cr towards working capital and ₹7 cr towards repaying loans; debt to equity was 1.69 before the issue. At the upper band the post-issue P/E is about 23.9x, just below the 26.1x median of listed peers, but the price to book of about 2.0x is well above theirs, and the top ten customers bring in about 70% of revenue.

checks.name: Revenue growth
checks.finding: Revenue went from ₹210.03 cr (FY24) to ₹223.03 cr (FY26), a CAGR of only about 3.0%.

checks.name: Revenue rose every year
checks.finding: Revenue fell to ₹193.46 cr in FY25 from ₹210.03 cr in FY24, then rose to ₹223.03 cr in FY26.

checks.name: Debt to equity
checks.finding: Debt to equity was 1.69 in FY26 (borrowings ₹75.00 cr vs net worth ₹44.46 cr).

checks.name: Debt growing slower than revenue
checks.finding: Borrowings rose about 6.9% (₹70.13 cr in FY24 to ₹75.00 cr in FY26), slightly faster than revenue (+6.2%).

checks.name: Net worth rising
checks.finding: Net worth rose every year: ₹26.69 cr, ₹37.32 cr, ₹44.46 cr (FY24–FY26).

checks.name: Positive operating cash flow
checks.finding: Operating cash flow was ₹15.75 cr in FY26, about twice the ₹7.91 cr profit.

checks.name: Profit growth
checks.finding: Profit after tax grew 54.5% in FY26, from ₹5.12 cr to ₹7.91 cr.

checks.name: Profit margin trend
checks.finding: Net margin improved from 1.80% (FY24) to 2.64% (FY25) and 3.55% (FY26).

checks.name: Return on equity
checks.finding: Return on net worth was 17.79% in FY26, up from 13.71% in FY25.

checks.name: Return on capital employed
checks.finding: ROCE was 17.41% in FY26, up from 15.32% in FY25.

checks.name: Margin vs listed peers
checks.finding: Peer profit or EBITDA margins were not found in public sources.

checks.name: P/E vs listed peers
checks.finding: Post-issue P/E of about 23.9x (₹189.09 cr market cap on 1,05,05,245 shares at ₹180 ÷ ₹7.91 cr FY26 PAT) vs a peer median of 26.1x (Shetron 26.1x, Kaira Can 69.8x, Rajeshwari Cans 6.6x).

checks.name: Price to book vs listed peers
checks.finding: Post-issue price to book of about 2.0x (₹189.09 cr ÷ ₹93.96 cr, i.e. ₹44.46 cr FY26 net worth + ₹49.5 cr fresh issue) vs a peer median of 1.38x, about 46% above.

checks.name: Market cap to sales vs listed peers
checks.finding: Post-issue market cap to FY26 revenue is about 0.85x (₹189.09 cr ÷ ₹223.03 cr), but peer market cap to sales figures were not found.
